messages:
Sam: Anyone down for a tiny spring fantasy baseball league? 6 teams, $5 buy-in, draft next Wed at 6pm. Winner gets the mini pennant and eternal bragging rights. :baseball: :trophy:
Rhea: Im in. Love a cheap season. Draft time works for me.
Jon: In if theres a pancake stack involved. Also can we do auto-pick backups? My brain melts at 6pm. :pancakes:
Lily: Auto-pick yes. Also proposing a snack poll for draft night: pancakes, sliders, or doughnuts? React with :pancakes:, :hamburger:, or :doughnut:.
marco-bot: Poll created: "Draft Night Snacks" (pancakes :pancakes:, sliders :hamburger:, doughnuts :doughnut:)
Sam: Draft rules: snake, 10 rounds, 90s pick timer. Auto-pick if youre AFK. Also winner chooses next months office snack.
Rhea: Ill bring a small pennant I made last year. Also volunteer to manage the draft order.
Jon: Vote doughnuts. But I will reluctantly accept pancakes if Lily promises maple syrup.
Lily: Maple syrup guaranteed. Ill also bring a tiny hand-trophy for the draft winner. :sparkles:
marco-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Fantasy Baseball Draft" Wed 18:00.
Sam: OK sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/spring-fantasy-signup. Reply here when youre in and Ill collect $5 Venmo.
Rhea: Signed up. Excited for nonsense and terrible waiver moves. :joy:
